resources.string: Something went wrong. Your existing records were not changed. Try again.
Android could not read or write the selected file. Choose an available location and try again.
Your records were updated, but a private temporary or photo file still needs cleanup. Restart the app and retry Delete data if needed.
Set up a treatment first.
A treatment already exists. Delete it or explicitly restore a replacement backup first.
This treatment is completed. Start a new phase before adding treatment changes.
Check the treatment dates, tray counts, interval, prescribed target, and time zone.
The device clock moved backwards. Correct it before recording a new action. Existing records are unchanged.
The device clock is at or before the previous switch. Correct the clock or previous switch time, then try again.
The device clock precedes the current tray or last switch. Correct it before advancing.
The device clock precedes existing treatment history. Correct it before starting or completing a phase.
The event limit was reached. Export your history before starting another treatment or phase.
That switch no longer exists. Refresh history and try again.
The initial tracking event cannot be moved.
Choose a switch time within tracked treatment time, before completion, and strictly between adjacent switches.
The missing interval end must follow its start.
Keep the missing interval strictly inside one existing tracked interval.
The missing interval must differ from the surrounding IN or OUT state.
A missing interval cannot overlap untracked coverage.
The untracked interval must be within treatment history and cannot overlap another untracked interval.
This is the last tray. Complete treatment or explicitly start a new phase when appropriate.
Only the active existing phase schedule can be changed.
Check that the schedule covers every tray once, without gaps or overlaps, using intervals from 1 to 365 days.
The schedule reason is too long.
Choose the current IN or OUT state when resuming a completed treatment.
Enter a phase name, 1 to 1,000 trays, and a tray interval from 1 to 365 days.
The prescribed target must be from 1 to 1,440 minutes.
A target change cannot rewrite past target history.
That note no longer exists. Refresh the journal and try again.
Enter note text and choose a time that is not in the future.
That appointment no longer exists. Refresh the journal and try again.
Enter an appointment title and check its time, duration, note, and reminder.
That photo no longer exists or its private copy is missing. Refresh photos and try again.
Choose a supported image under the stated size limit and check its date and caption.
Android could not decode the selected image. Choose another supported image.
The photo could not be saved to private storage. Check available device storage and try again.
Choose between 2 and 100 photos for a time-lapse.
The time-lapse is larger than 16 MiB. Select fewer photos.
The break reminder must be from 1 to 240 minutes.
Use a password from 12 to 1,024 characters.
Enter the backup password, using at most 1,024 characters.
The password is incorrect or the backup is damaged. Your existing data is unchanged.
The backup is too large. Remove photos or export less content, then try again.
This backup version or encryption setting is not supported by this app.
The selected file is not a valid Aligner Tracker backup. Your existing data is unchanged.
This JSON refers to photos. Import its complete portable archive instead.
A backup photo is missing, damaged, unreadable, or has invalid dimensions. Your existing data is unchanged.
A private photo is missing or damaged. Existing records are unchanged; restore its complete archive or remove its record before exporting.
The selected record changed or no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
Stored or imported treatment data is invalid. Existing records were not changed.
